AI agents and agentic apps in Oracle Fusion 26D

What our 26D What's New extract actually contains for AI agents, agentic apps and assistants — and what it does not.

In short: Honest scope: Oracle's 26D What's New Feature Summary tables for the modules we cover do not currently include a row titled Fusion Claw or AI Agent Studio. Partner writeups often use those names; this page only lists rows that already appear in our extract. We found 35 26D features whose Oracle title mentions an AI agent, an agentic app, or an assistant, and none titled Fusion Claw or AI Agent Studio. Enablement below is Oracle's Action to Enable column. Start from the 26D changes list and confirm behaviour in your test pod before production.

Every row below comes from Oracle's Feature Summary tables in the 26D What's New documents for the modules we cover. Titles and Action to Enable are Oracle's. We recheck them every week.

Frequently asked questions

Does Fusion Updates list Fusion Claw in 26D?

Not under that title. As of our current 26D What's New extract for Financials, Procurement, SCM, Logistics, Projects and HCM, no Feature Summary row is titled Fusion Claw. If Oracle publishes one later for a module we cover, the weekly refresh will pick it up.

Does Fusion Updates list AI Agent Studio in 26D?

Not in the 26D Feature Summary tables for the modules we cover. Our extract does include AI Agent Studio rows in earlier releases (26B, 26C). See the earlier-releases section on this page.

How many 26D features mention AI agents or assistants?

35 unique features (by title and module family) in Oracle's 26D What's New for the modules we cover, matching titles that contain AI agent, agentic, assistant, claw or agent studio.

Where do the enablement labels come from?

Oracle's Action to Enable column on each feature's What's New row. We copy it; we do not invent AI-unit budgets or guardrail counts.
